run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways to cover a given distance using steps of 1, 2, or 3
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple distance inputs and compare results with a filled implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that counts ways to cover a distance
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness of the triple-step recurrence relation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization instead of an array-based dynamic programming approach
